title: Khayal — Your Body. Chat’s Playground. | Twitch Shadow Theatre Gameplay
description:
Chat sends the spirits. Your shadow guards the light.

Khayal (خيال) is a local Twitch shadow theatre inspired by Egyptian shadow performance. Chat commands bring cut-paper puppets to life; a camera silhouette protects five lanterns in a 60-second Afreet Hunt.

This 1:54 gameplay demo includes genuine Twitch chat and camera recordings from an agent-operated broadcaster test, a short explicitly labeled simulator rehearsal, the director’s cue book, an exported playbill and an explanation of how Codex helped build the app. Source labels remain visible throughout. The channel was offline during the Twitch tests; this is an early-build review, not evidence of a multi-viewer live broadcast. Human fairness, deliberate-swat accuracy, sustained OBS performance and real follow/raid checks remain pending.

Source and local setup: https://github.com/AmirmLotfy/Khayal
Project: https://devpost.com/software/khayal

Built with TypeScript, Vite, PixiJS and MediaPipe Tasks Vision, with Codex used for implementation and verification. Camera segmentation runs locally; the app has no camera-upload backend.

The thumbnail is AI-assisted promotional illustration, not a gameplay capture. Gameplay uses the app’s original cyanotype vector artwork. English narration supplied by the creator; English captions included.

Bring your shadow. Guard the light.
